visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women and two young boys are standing in front of a tall grey stone pillar with Japanese characters carved into it. One woman wears a beige trench coat and waves at the camera with a big smile. The other woman wears a brown puffer jacket and holds a phone. The two boys are positioned in front of them, wearing colorful, multi-patterned fleece jackets. The background consists of tall green hedges and a blue sky with soft white clouds. (2) A young boy with glasses is looking closely at a wooden shelf filled with dozens of red Daruma dolls of various sizes. The setting is a traditional Japanese wooden structure. (3) A close-up shot shows a wooden sign with black text on a white background, listing admission fees in Japanese and English. (4) A young boy sits on a gravel path, smiling and making a peace sign, with a small red doll next to him. (5) A woman in a beige coat walks with the two boys through a temple courtyard filled with many visitors. Traditional red Japanese temple gates and buildings are visible in the background. (6) The woman stands by a large pond with a scenic view of forested hills and a red bridge. She points toward the scenery while talking. (7) Close-up shots show children's feet climbing stone stairs, followed by the boys making peace signs in front of a wall of Daruma dolls. (8) A wall of wooden plaques with Japanese calligraphy is shown. Small red dolls are tucked into crevices of the wooden beams. (9) A boy squats down to look at a cluster of small dolls placed in a hole in a stone wall. Cartoonish white mice are digitally overlaid onto the dolls. (10) Wide shots capture hundreds of small red dolls placed along rooftops and throughout the temple grounds. (11) The woman holds up blank postcards at a stamp station. A boy is seen pressing a large wooden stamp onto a card. (12) A large, ornate red Japanese temple hall with gold accents stands under a cloudy sky. (13) The family walks past stone lanterns. A small waterfall flows into a pond near a red torii gate. (14) Inside a brightly lit souvenir shop, the woman and boys carry shopping baskets filled with packaged snacks and merchandise. They show off their purchases with excited expressions. (15) The family walks toward the camera on a path near the entrance. The woman smiles and speaks directly to the lens.
